# Golixco

Golixco builds software and products with modern AI, creativity and experimentation.
The name originated as an online identity in 2020; this is not a formal founding date.
Company leadership identities and business metrics have not been publicly disclosed.

## Lolixco — live public beta
https://lol.golixco.com/
Cinematic video-edit discovery and experimental AI-assisted edit analysis for movies, series, anime and gaming.
Discover edits through Home, Explore, Search, Shorts, Shuffle, Edit of the Moment and Immersion.
The initial launch catalog contained 57 edits: 27 YouTube-hosted and 30 Lolixco-hosted; this is not a real-time count.
Creator Studio accepts compatible local videos and eligible public YouTube URLs. It combines local media-signal analysis with Gemini-supported semantic understanding where available.
Six experimental dimensions: Beat Synchronization / Audiovisual Rhythm; Cuts & Transitions; Pacing; Visual Craftsmanship; Storytelling & Coherence; Creative Execution & Impact.
Accuracy is not guaranteed. Some analyses provide supported partial feedback rather than all six scores.
